<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X)/2 and the given molecular formula C8H14NO (X = 0), the calculation is DBE = (2·8 + 2 + 1 – 14)/2 = (16 + 2 + 1 – 14)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the conventional interpretation for this formula yields a DBE of 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
